issue.title: test: tencent-cloud.test.cjs (WebKit, en) failed once in a parallel GUI run
issue.body:
Seen while the #1574 (Token Plan 企业版) work was verified, around c05dd8b6f/1d016ee3f.

- `internal/gui/tests/tencent-cloud.test.cjs`, WebKit, English, failed once when run together with other GUI tests in parallel.
- Alone it passed 4 of 4, and every rerun since passed.
- The failing output wasn't kept, so the cause isn't known yet.

A red under load is a timing assumption a user can meet on a busy machine (LESSONS.md). Next step: run it in parallel with the other GUI tests under load, or inject a delay into the region/tile render, keep the failing output, and fix the cause rather than retrying.

comments.body:
The red was the test's own wall-clock budgets, not the app. Two were load-sensitive:

- `page.setDefaultTimeout(5000)`: `#addProvider` stays hidden while the `/api/providers` read the tiles and region strip render from is still in flight, so a late read under a loaded runner left `locator.click` past the 5s budget (`TimeoutError`, "element is not visible").
- `posted()`'s 50×50ms poll: a post (site/keys page opened, a save) can follow its click by seconds on a busy machine; the poll gave up and the assert compared `undefined` against the expected URL.

The branch raises the default to 15s and makes `posted()` wait for the post's arrival (the route handler wakes it) instead of polling, with a 30s cap that names the post that never arrived. The #1620 30ms beat stays as it is.

A new test, `webkit en: a late providers read and late posts are still waited for`, holds the read and the POSTs back 6s and still expects the flow through. On the old bounds it failed twice: first `TimeoutError: Timeout 5000ms exceeded` at `#addProvider`, then — with only the timeout raised — `expected undefined to strictly equal 'https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1300/78939'`. With the fix: 13 pass, 0 fail in the file (chromium and webkit, en and zh), and 13 pass, 0 fail again under a 14-file parallel GUI run. `gofmt -l`, `go build ./...` and `go vet ./internal/gui/` clean (no Go changes).

[fix/1579-test-tencent-cloud-test-cjs](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/1579-test-tencent-cloud-test-cjs), commit 20b35df5546b548739c38e67d7258031c4bd12e2. A fork branch, ready to review — no claim on the issue.
